**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**Do you want to be at the forefront of managing initiatives that enable next-generation Laser Systems for quantum computers, sensors, and communication systems? Do you thrive on turning complex challenges into structured plans and delivering results that push the boundaries of innovation?

**Then this job as Technical Project Manager for Quantum Systems at Hamamatsu Photonics may be the right job for you!

Being in the middle of the second quantum revolution, this is a great time to join us. Our continued success has set us on an exciting growth path—not just in Denmark, but across our global organization. Hamamatsu Photonics, is an inspiring place to work, where we encourage both personal and career development.

You will join a highly skilled and dedicated team of engineers and scientists and play a key role in ensuring successful delivery of projects that develop advanced laser systems and accessories for top-tier quantum technology customers.

**The Role:

**As a member of our Quantum Systems engineering team, you will lead the development, assembly, and testing of custom laser system products and prototypes based on ultra-stable fiber lasers. You interface with sales and support teams to provide updates on product developments and technical advice on customer enquiries as well as assisting with after sales support and repairs/upgrades.

**We are passionate about Quantum Technology! If you are enthusiastic about quantum technologies and computing too, in this position you will:

**

• Lead and manage technical projects from concept to delivery, ensuring timelines, budgets, and quality standards are met following Hamamatsu Photonics Product and Prototype development processes

• Coordinate cross-functional teams of optical, mechanical and electronics engineers, commercial stake holders, and production specialists to achieve project goals

• Act as the primary point of contact for internal stakeholders and external customers, providing clear communication and progress updates.

• Develop project plans, risk assessments, and resource allocations to ensure smooth execution.

• Support strategic decision-making by providing insights on project feasibility, technical challenges, and customer requirements.

**More about you:

**As a strong candidate for this position, we hope that you can tick all or most of the following boxes:

• A relevant educational qualification (Master level) is required, preferably gained within a photonics research environment

• Strong background in project management within high-tech or engineering environments (ideally in an industrial context)

• Experience with complex, multi-disciplinary projects, ideally in photonics, optics, or quantum technologies.

• Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage stakeholders at all levels.

• Familiarity with project management tools and methodologies (e.g. PRINCE or similar).

• A proactive mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, innovative environment

• Fluent in English (written and spoken)

• Willingness to travel up to 10% annually, potentially globally

We want you to feel supported, both at work and outside it. Our benefits include:

• A 12% employer-paid pension contribution and health insurance.

• An annual bonus program.

• 25 days of paid vacation, plus five additional days once you have been with us for nine months.

• Access to thousands of courses through LinkedIn Learning.

• Wellbeing initiatives and an annual flu vaccination.

• Freshly prepared meals from our subsidised on-site canteen.

• Free parking at our Birkerød site.

• Social activities through our Employee Association.

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

**Principal Consultant - AI & Data Advisory

**The Role:

**NNIT is strengthening its Advisory & AI capability to help life sciences clients turn AI and data ambition into

measurable business outcomes. We are looking for an experienced management consultant with strong

commercial capabilities who can originate opportunities, advise senior executives, shape compelling

transformation agendas, and convert them into high-value client engagements. Technology understanding is

required, but the primary mandate is management consulting, commercial growth and trusted executive

advisory.

The role sits in AI & Data Advisory under Advisory & AI and works across R&D, Manufacturing, Supply Chain

and cross-functional regulated capabilities. It is a client- and market-facing management consulting role that

opens and support senior conversations, frames business value and creates demand. The role then connects

qualified opportunities to NNIT domain and technology specialists, including our AI Factory in the Philippines,

without being expected to act as the lead technologist or solution architect. However, the person should be able

to drive projects as engagement manager as well.

**Your responsibilities as Principal Consultant - AI & Data Advisory:

Deliver and manage senior AI & Data advisory engagements: Deliver senior management consulting

engagements covering AI strategy and governance, AI readiness, data and analytics strategy, AI-enabled

quality and continuous improvement, transformation programs, and AI-enabled operating models. Frame the

business choices, organizational implications, investment priorities and value case.

Deliver and develop AI & Data Advisory offerings: Position, sell and deliver NNIT’s portfolio of AI and data

management consulting offerings. The AI Value Compass is one example. Use client engagements, market

insight and commercial experience to provide structured input to the development, refinement and scaling of

additional offerings. Facilitate executive discovery and decision-making, assess opportunities and readiness,

prioritize value pools and translate outcomes into board-ready narratives, business cases, roadmaps and clear

next steps.

Convert advisory into implementation and measurable value: Use advisory engagements and the broader

offering portfolio to create credible follow-on opportunities across transformation, implementation, validation and

managed services. Maintain senior client sponsorship and commercial continuity while appropriately handing

technical design and execution to the relevant specialists.

Bridge clients, domains and the AI Factory: Act as the commercial and consulting bridge between client

executives, NNIT business areas and AI delivery capacity in the Philippines. Translate business priorities into a

clear engagement scope and value case, bring in architects and technical specialists at the right time, and retain

accountability for the client relationship, commercial outcome and realized value.

Shape AI and data solutions across Life Sciences: Work across Clinical, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Supply

Chain, Quality and other regulated areas to identify strategically important client problems and shape crosscapability responses. Use sufficient AI and data understanding to challenge, qualify and explain solutions, while

drawing on NNIT specialists for technical depth.

Drive commercial growth with Sales and other Business Areas: Carry a clear commercial mandate to

originate and qualify opportunities, build executive relationships, shape client demand, lead proposals and RfPs,

develop Statements of Work and commercial cases, and convert advisory entry points into larger multi-service

relationships. Contribute directly to pipeline, bookings, revenue and account growth.

Strengthen repeatable offerings and assets: Actively contribute to the development and commercialisation of

new AI and data advisory offerings. Bring recurring client needs, market insight and delivery experience into

offering design; help test propositions with clients; and refine methods, executive workshop formats, commercial

narratives, pricing logic and reusable assets in partnership with domain and technology specialists.

Represent NNIT in the market: Build executive credibility through client events, industry forums, thought

leadership and strategic partnerships, positioning NNIT around business outcomes, regulated execution and

responsible AI.

Line-manage and develop consultants: Act as line manager for a small team of consultants, with

responsibility for regular one-to-ones, performance and development conversations, staffing input, coaching and

creating clear expectations. Support consultants in executive advisory, problem structuring, value-case

development, commercial shaping and account development.

****What You Will Work On

****Typical management consulting engagements may include:

• AI strategy, governance and readiness assessments for regulated life sciences organizations

• AI and data strategy, discovery, and value-assessment engagements, including e.g. the AI Value Compass as one available offering, followed where relevant by transformation or value-realization programs

• Data and analytics strategy, data readiness and trusted data foundations for AI

• AI-enabled Quality, risk, knowledge and continuous-improvement initiatives

• Agentic workflows and AI-enabled operating model design, with appropriate human oversight and governance

• Client-specific AI and data solutions delivered with NNIT domain specialists and the AI Factory

****Your Qualifications And Experience:

• 10+ years of management consulting experience, preferably from a recognized strategy, management or technology consulting firm, with a strong record in life sciences or other regulated industries. Senior

• Principal candidates should demonstrate broader C-level relationships, substantial commercial ownership and account growth, together with experience managing and developing consultants.

• Proven management consulting toolkit: hypothesis-led problem solving, executive interviewing and facilitation, operating model and transformation design, quantitative value-case development, and concise board-level storytelling.

• Sufficient understanding of AI strategy, responsible AI and governance, data strategy, analytics, GenAI and agentic approaches to advise executives, challenge assumptions and work credibly with specialists. Deep hands-on engineering or architecture expertise is not required.

• Life sciences experience strongly preferred, including an understanding of regulated environments and the implications of GxP, quality, validation and data governance for AI-enabled solutions.

• Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous problems, build executive alignment, develop business cases and transformation roadmaps, and maintain senior sponsorship as work moves into implementation and value tracking.

• Strong commercial track record in originating consulting opportunities, opening new executive relationships, expanding strategic accounts, leading proposals/RfPs, negotiating scope and commercials, and shaping Statements of Work.

• Ability to mobilize and coordinate multidisciplinary teams across management consulting, life sciences domains, architecture, data/AI and distributed delivery, without needing to be the deepest technical expert.

• Experience as a people or line manager, including performance management, development planning, coaching and supporting staffing decisions.

• Strong facilitation, storytelling and executive presentation skills. Fluency in English is required. Danish and/or German language skills would be a distinct advantage.

****What Success Looks Like:

• Clients see you as a trusted management consultant who can frame complex choices, create executive alignment and connect AI and data investments to measurable business outcomes.

• AI and data advisory engagements, including the AI Value Compass where relevant, convert into credible roadmaps and, where appropriate, implementation and longer-term value partnerships.

• The AI Factory is connected to commercially qualified, well-shaped client demand, with clear ownership between advisory, technology specialists and delivery.

• AI and data work pulls through NNIT domain, platform, validation and managed-service capabilities without creating a separate silo

• Client work creates reusable assets and referenceable outcomes that strengthen NNIT’s market position and future pipeline.

****Why Join Advisory & AI:

****This role is positioned at the front of NNIT’s client agenda: opening strategic conversations, building trusted

executive relationships, framing value and converting demand into material consulting and transformation

engagements. You will work across NNIT’s life sciences domains, deliver existing offerings and provide marketled input to develop the next generation of AI and data advisory propositions, supported by NNIT’s domain and

technology specialists.

****About NNIT:

****NNIT provides consulting and IT services to life sciences and other regulated organizations. Our direction is to

combine deep domain expertise, advisory, technology and global delivery to create tangible customer impact. In

this role, that means bringing AI and data into real regulated business contexts and ensuring that ideas move

from executive ambition to scalable execution.

****About NNIT

****NNIT is a publicly listed company that specializes in IT solutions to life sciences internationally, and to the public and enterprise sectors in Denmark. We focus on high complexity industries and thrive in environments where regulatory demands and complexity are high. We advise on and build sustainable digital solutions that work for the patients, citizens, employees, end users or customers.

NNIT consists of group company NNIT A/S and subsidiaries SCALES, Excellis Health Solutions and SL Controls. Together, these companies employ more than 1,600 people in Europe, Asia, and USA.

We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. We actively work to eliminate bias and ensure an inclusive workplace where everyone has the right to be seen and heard as they are. We invite interested candidates to apply, no matter their background.

In the interest of fostering a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request candidates to refrain from including their pictures in their applications.

Learn more about working at NNIT

Apply now and liberate your talent!

**Role

**The Senior Manager, Inspection Readiness - Good Clinical Practice, plays a key role in supporting the Clinical Trial Operations organization by embedding clinical compliance and inspection readiness into clinical trials and service provider oversight. This position is essential for maintaining a high level of clinical trial inspection readiness while ensuring adherence to Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines and applicable regulatory requirements. The individual will also lead process improvement initiatives.

This is an individual contributor role at the Senior Manager level, reporting to the Director, Trial Delivery Team Lead.

**Responsibilities

****Trial Inspection Readiness and Preparation

**

• Design and optimize tools and processes for trial inspection readiness, leveraging digitalization and automation to improve efficiency and compliance.

• Guide study teams in maintaining trial inspection readiness by providing GCP and clinical compliance support, including risk identification, mitigation and monitoring; management of serious GCP breaches and other reportable or non-reportable persistent non-compliance events; and follow-up and closure of quality events, thereby strengthening sponsor oversight.

• Conduct ongoing assessments of compound and/or trial inspection readiness by analyzing key metrics to generate actionable insights.

• Lead the development and delivery of GCP inspection readiness training and tools for Clinical Trial Operations and other key stakeholders.

• Collaborate closely with GCP QA to support the operational framework and inspection setup during sponsor, site and vendor GCP inspections.

• Facilitate lessons-learned activities based on inspection readiness assessments, preparations and outcomes within Clinical Trial Operations.

**Quality Events Oversight

**

• Maintain oversight of Clinical Trial Delivery quality events and effectiveness checks, ensuring compliance with applicable requirements.

• Analyze trends in findings from audits, inspections and quality events, as relevant to Clinical Trial Operations and other key stakeholders.

**Clinical Compliance

**

• Provide guidance and support on ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA and NMPA) and Genmab SOPs.

• Lead and contribute to functional and/or cross-functional business process improvements, system enhancements and innovative initiatives.

**Requirements

**

• Bachelor’s (BSc) or master’s degree (MSc) in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Medicine or a related discipline.

• A minimum of 8 years of experience in Clinical Operations, Clinical Quality, Inspection Readiness or Clinical Compliance within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.

• Strong understanding of clinical trial processes, ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations and the clinical drug development lifecycle.

• Strong project management skills and knowledge of relevant tools and processes.

• Experience mentoring colleagues and supporting their professional development.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to proactively identify risks, develop mitigation strategies and effectively resolve issues.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions in a complex, global, matrix organization.

$130,720.00---$196,080.00

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When You Join Genmab, You’re Joining a Culture That Supports Your Physical, Financial, Social, And Emotional Wellness. Within The First Year, Regular Full-time U.S. Employees Are Eligible For

• 401(k) Plan: 100% match on the first 6% of contributions

• Health Benefits: Two medical plan options (including HDHP with HSA), dental, and vision insurance

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Please note that if you are applying for a position in the Netherlands, Genmab’s policy for all permanently budgeted hires in NL is initially to offer a fixed-term employment contract for a year, if the employee performs well and if the business conditions do not change, renewal for an indefinite term may be considered after the fixed-term employment contract.

Do you want to use your experience and skills within microwave engineering and be a part of designing the next generation of our advanced Doppler radars?

Then this is your chance to join Weibel in a position as Senior RF Engineer in our Antenna group. We can offer an exciting opportunity where you can use your technical skills in an innovative environment where our goal is to push the performance of radars to the limit. We have a full-scale production facility close to our developers – this is our key strength that allows us to drive new solutions and technology at world class quality level.

Due to increasing demand for our products, we are looking for a new colleague for a position as Senior RF Engineer to strengthen our Antenna group. Our antennas are designed, tested and produced in-house at our headquarter in Allerød. The active antenna arrays contain both RF, analog, power and digital control electronics, giving you an opportunity to work closely together with colleagues who have a different field of expertise than yourself.

Continuing a legacy of extremely high accuracy with a new generation of solutions

You will be part of the team that designs and verifies the microwave components going into our instrumentation and tracking radars. The group designs almost all electronic elements of the radar antennas including antenna elements, mixers, LNAs, HPAs, PSUs and digital circuits. We play a key role in our certification activities and support the production team with module testing, system verification, and debugging.

In this role, you will work with system-level debugging and testing—both internally and as part of our certification processes—while also contributing to design tasks in our ongoing roadmap projects.

Your main responsibility includes the following tasks:

• Drive the design of various microwave PCBs and modules

• Test and verify performance of the developed solutions – both on board level and module level.

• Work closely with system engineering and subsystem architects to align module requirements

• Drive needed documentation like requirements, design specifications, test specifications and production documentation.

• Work closely with NPI team in developing efficient test solutions.

• Collaborate with your engineering colleagues to find the best cross-functional solution

Other responsibilities and tasks will be:

• Take part in the development of our next generation radar platform architecture

• Support system-level debugging, troubleshooting and integration.

• Include compliance requirements in designs and support compliance team

About you

We are looking for an experienced colleague and ideally +10 years of experience from a similar role. You can quickly get up to speed with ongoing design, debugging, and compliance tasks while building an understanding of the design trade-offs relevant to radar systems. Hands-on experience with debugging in a live environment is a strong advantage. The role requires a detail-oriented and structured approach, combined with the ability to maintain an overall view of the system and meet project deadlines.

The essential requirements of the job include:

• A university degree in electrical engineering with focus on RF

• +10 years’ experience in advanced RF designs.

• Experience with design of microwave circuits and debugging

• Experience with microwave measuring instruments such as VNAs, spectrum analyzers, and signal generators

• Experience with HPA and LNA design

• System-level understanding of radar architecture

• Knowledge of electromagnetic theory and free space waves

Your new team

The Antenna group consists of more than 50 engineers ranging from few years to 30+ years of experience - of these 18 engineers make the Microwave team. The Antenna group is cross functional engineering team with analogue and digital electronics, RF or microwave electronics and mechanical engineering – all skills to deliver a full functional Antenna.

Contact and application

Please note that we review applications on an on-going basis. Please apply at our website using the ”Apply” button. Applications can be in Danish or English. If you have any questions, you are very welcome to contact Engineering Manager Microwave, Thomas Madsen, thm@weibel.dk.

The deadline is November 25th, 2026.

Please be aware that it is a requirement for this position that you can provide a criminal record with no remarks and obtain a security clearance.

We are looking forward to hearing from you.

**The Impact You'll Make

**As our Production Business Consultant, you will shape how production planning and execution work across Danfoss Power Electronics & Drives (DPD). You will help create standardized, scalable processes and SAP S/4HANA solutions that translate into measurable improvements in day-to-day production.

Acting as the link between production and IT, you’ll turn business needs into practical solutions and take ownership of production processes across the DPD organization. You will work globally with Supply Chain, Digital & IT, and production stakeholders to improve efficiency, increase productivity, and support a more digital and sustainable way of working.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Own and continuously improve global SAP production planning and execution processes, ensuring solutions are standardized, scalable, and aligned across DPD.

• Translate production needs into effective SAP solutions, working closely with business and IT stakeholders on improvements, implementations, rollouts, and retrofit initiatives.

• Lead continuous business improvement to increase productivity, shorten cycle times, improve throughput, and reduce costs through standardization and automation.

• Safeguard successful implementation, including data quality, user acceptance and end-to-end testing, go-live readiness, stabilization, and change management.

• Build strong process ownership across sites by coaching key users, coordinating change requests, and identifying opportunities for digitalization and automated processing.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Solid hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA production planning and execution, combined with a good understanding of end-to-end manufacturing processes.

• Experience supporting or leading SAP implementations, rollouts, or retrofit projects in a production environment.

• Solid knowledge of production master data and relevant processes such as serialization, batch management, and integration with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES).

• Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn operational challenges into practical process and system improvements.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with professional English and the ability to collaborate effectively across functions, cultures, and locations.

Experience identifying automation or digitalization opportunities in production is an advantage. You should also be comfortable working in a global organization and travelling occasionally when needed.

**What You'll Get From Us

**You will help engineer a better future by contributing to solutions that make a real difference around the world.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence how production processes and SAP solutions are designed and used across a global organization, while building relationships across production, Supply Chain, and Digital & IT.

We will support your career growth with mentoring, learning opportunities, and access to global career paths.

You will have the flexibility, autonomy, and support you need to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

You will be part of an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds are respected, valued, and empowered to succeed.

You will receive a competitive rewards package that includes benefits such as an annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, health insurance, and more. As a global company, these benefits vary by country and contract.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you are excited about combining SAP expertise with real-world production improvement, we’d like to hear from you. Even if you don’t meet every preferred qualification, we encourage you to apply if this opportunity matches your experience and ambitions.

Join us and help shape production processes that are simpler, smarter, and ready for the future.

Senior Manager, Strategy & Transformation

Experience

• Senior Manager, Strategy & Transformation

Are you motivated by helping organizations with business transformations – often driven by AI, data and digital technology? And would you like to combine advisory work with client relationships and business development of Valcon?

As a Senior Manager in our Strategy & Transformation team, you will work closely with clients to solve complex business challenges and help turn strategic ambitions into sustainable results. You will take a leading role in client engagements while contributing to the continued development and growth of our Strategy & Transformation offerings.

Role and profile

You will work particularly within strategic business transformation, operating models and leading people through change to help our clients navigate complex projects in an environment increasingly shaped by AI, data and digital technology. You will build strong relationships with clients, understand their challenges and translate these into impactful transformation initiatives. Depending on the engagement, you may lead larger projects and work alongside other colleagues in multidisciplinary Valcon teams.

You bring solid experience from management consulting and are comfortable moving between strategic thinking and practical execution. Relevant work experience of minimum 8 years is expected. Experience with AI, Data or Technology driven Business Transformation is a clear advantage.

To thrive in the role, you will contribute across three equally areas:

• Client delivery and engagement: Lead and deliver complex transformations and critical projects fronting office-floor employees and executives, from mobilisation through implementation, creating strong collaboration and high-quality business impact.

• Commercial growth: Build trusted client relationships, understand client needs and identify opportunities where Valcon can create added value.

• Service development: Further develop our Strategy & Transformation capabilities, methodologies and approaches, with AI, data and technology as an important driver.

You will have a high degree of autonomy while being part of a collaborative team where we develop solutions, client relationships and capabilities together.

What you bring

• Strategy & transformation experience: You have strong experience within strategic transformations, change leadership and operating models and able to move from ambition to execution to value.

• Consulting skills: You are comfortable taking responsibility, navigating and solving complex problems, and collaborating closely with clients and colleagues to find the right way forward in high paced environments.

• People skills: You enjoy working with people and know how to build trust, communicate and engage stakeholders and create direction in teams and client relationships.

• Business acumen: You think business impact while keeping a pragmatic focus on what works in practice.

• Tech Savvy and Curiosity: You are curious about how AI, data and digital technology are changing businesses and is continuously developing yourself in this space.

• Education and language: You have relevant higher education or equivalent professional experience and communicate fluently and professionally in English. Danish is an advantage.

Location and travel

The role is based at Valcon’s offices in central Copenhagen or Aarhus, Denmark. You can expect travel in connection with client meetings and project work, primarily within Denmark and the Nordic region.

About Valcon

We are a European powerhouse in AI and data-driven business transformation, bringing this to life by integrating management consulting with data and digital technology capabilities.

We ensure companies are in their best possible shape – fit for the future. We spot opportunities and help bring them to life. We are thorough, fast and collaborative in everything we do. From the boardroom to the shop floor. From strategy to operations.

We are a no-nonsense consultancy with curious individuals who are driven by creating value together with clients. We have an informal culture and a flat hierarchy with offices in Denmark, Sweden, the Netherlands, the UK, Germany, Croatia and Serbia.

Application

If this role sounds like a good match, we warmly encourage you to apply and share how your experience, strengths and perspective could contribute to the team. Deadline for applications is Monday December 7, but we do review applications on an ongoing basis.

jobs.description:
Would you like to lead the Accounting Data & Monitoring team in Reporting Solutions responsible for several business-critical data hubs of accounting and financial data used in business solutions and reporting processes? jobs.occupation: Management Consultants in Supply Chain Planning – Graduates 2027
jobs.description:
Job description

We're looking for talented and curious graduates who want to start a career in management consulting at the intersection of deep functional expertise and digital planning solutions.

What you’ll do

In this role, you’ll be joining a nerdy team that designs and delivers optimal supply chains by combining best-in-class processes with leading digital solutions. Every day, we help clients transform their planning processes in demand, supply, and inventory optimisation across the value chain and planning horizons.

You’ll be working on a wide range of projects. Depending on your personal journey and development goals, your role in a project could include:

• Design and implement planning excellence: Apply advanced concepts in forecasting, demand and supply planning, S&OP/IBP, inventory optimisation, and operational planning to build robust, end‑to‑end planning processes.

• Enable adoption and capability building: Train stakeholders and facilitate client workshops to co-create designs, refine processes, and embed continuous improvement.

• Translate requirements into actionable processes: Convert business needs into well-defined process designs and implementation plans – with clear governance, data, and decision flows.

• Guide digital planning transformations: Advise clients on solution architecture and roadmaps for SAP IBP and other leading platforms from concept to configuration and adoption.

• Deliver measurable impact: Execute projects that optimise planning tools and processes, strengthen performance management, and build organisational capabilities that sustain excellence.

• You’re excited to live a year in Copenhagen to immerse yourself in our strong Implement culture while working in an international team and to build a broad network at Implement.

If this sounds like the kind of nerdery you would like to dive deep into, you’ll feel right at home in our team.

Please note that for the first year, you’ll be employed in our Copenhagen office, Implement’s HQ, before joining the Aarhus office.

What you’ll bring

As our new team member, you’ll be working at the forefront of supply chain transformation – integrating digital enablers with core business functions to create end-to-end impact, from strategy and design to implementation and adoption.

To be a great fit, you hold – or are about to complete – a master's degree in a relevant field such as engineering, supply chain, operations research, or business analytics, with strong academic results to show for it.

On top of that, we’re looking for someone who meets most of the following criteria:

• Relevant experience: Ideally, you’ve applied supply chain concepts through an internship, student role, or thesis project.

• Project-driven and adaptable: You enjoy working in a project-based setting, managing timelines, stakeholders, and changing priorities.

• Interest in digital tools: Ideally, you have exposure to SAP (e.g., SAP IBP) or other digital planning platforms or you are interested in building expertise in digital planning solutions.

• Analytical problem-solver: You love turning complex problems into clear insights and actionable solutions.

• Structured communicator: You can structure and deliver compelling presentations and workshops in English (proficiency in another European language is considered a plus, but not a requirement).

Supply chains are becoming one of the most strategically important – and technically complex – areas in business. If you want to be at the sharp end of that, join our team where curiosity is rewarded, diverse perspectives are valued, and where you will make an impact from day one.

What we offer

At Implement, a healthy, dynamic, and collaborative environment always comes first. You'll become part of a fast-growing, entrepreneurial Scandinavian consultancy that gives you the space to grow, lead, and innovate while creating real results for our clients.

• Build deep functional expertise: develop mastery across demand planning, supply planning, inventory optimisation, S&OP/IBP, and digital planning tools with ownership of end-to-end planning transformations.

• Hands-on from day one: work on client projects immediately, side by side with experienced consultants who elevate your strategic thinking and methodological rigour.

• Continuous development: get access to an ambitious internal training programme with keynotes, workshops, certifications, and mentoring to accelerate your professional and personal growth.

• High-trust culture: enjoy autonomy, support, and a flat hierarchy in a team that shares knowledge freely and continuously raises its standards.

• An exciting start to your career: Feel the energy and atmosphere at our Copenhagen HQ for one year, joining a cohort of international graduates. Build a community and engage in a steep learning programme into the world of supply chain planning before you move on to the Aarhus office.

Make your next move matter.

How to apply

Please include your CV, a cover letter, and your GPA for both your BSc and MSc.

Start date for this position flexible, either winter 2026/2027 or September/October 2027 in Copenhagen.

About Implement

Implement Consulting Group (founded 1996) is an international management consulting firm with 1,900+ employees. Headquartered in Copenhagen, we have 12 offices across the Nordics, the DACH region, and the United States, making us one of the largest European consultancies. We support organisations in delivering sustainable strategic, commercial, and operational transformations. To help our clients succeed with their most critical change initiatives, we aim to attract, develop, and promote the best talent by creating a unique, collaborative learning environment where people can follow their passion, shape their own careers, and choose their own leaders.

**About Sedna:

**Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising global trade, serving as the North Star for businesses navigating the complexities of international commerce. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. As we continue to grow and innovate, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our journey and contribute to our mission of transforming global trade.

You can find out more about us on our website: https://sedna.com/

**Role Snapshot

****Scope

**Owns a named portfolio of Premier and Strategic accounts globally. Co-owns renewals and expansion commercially with the AE. Owns the customer relationship, account health, success plan execution, and ensuring the customer is in the right place before the renewal conversation happens; Sales owns the close.

**Autonomy

**Operates independently with minimal management oversight. Escalates to Head of Customer Success on strategic or genuinely unusual situations only.

**Influence

**Directly shapes retention and growth outcomes on Sedna's highest-value accounts. Executive-level relationships and QBR ownership mean this role has material impact on revenue.

**Team

**Sets the standard for account management practice across the CS function. Acts as a reference point for regional CSMs on complex account situations.

**Role Overview

**The Enterprise Customer Success Manager owns Sedna's most commercially significant customer relationships. This is a senior, largely autonomous role for someone who is equally comfortable running an executive-level conversation and building the account infrastructure, success plans, health monitoring, renewal strategy, that makes that conversation credible.

The portfolio spans Premier and Strategic accounts globally. These are customers with high ARR, high complexity, and in many cases, long relationships that carry both genuine opportunity and genuine risk. The job is to hold those relationships well, act on signals before they become problems, and surface and progress commercial outcomes in partnership with Sales.

This is not a role that fits someone who needs clear direction on what to do next. The expectation is that you read the account, form a view, and act on it. The Head of Customer Success is there for strategic decisions and unusual situations, not routine account management.

**Key Responsibilities

****Account Ownership

**

• Own a named portfolio of Premier and Strategic accounts. Know them well enough that no renewal, no escalation, and no expansion conversation comes as a surprise.

• Build and maintain executive-level relationships. The relationship should not depend on the product working perfectly; it should be strong enough to hold when it does not.

• Produce and execute success plans tied to customer outcomes, not just product usage metrics. Plans should reflect what the customer is trying to achieve and how Sedna is contributing to it.

• Run QBRs with commercial framing. A QBR should advance the relationship and the commercial position, not just report on the quarter.

• Maintain deep product knowledge across Sedna Email, Prefix, and VMS. You are not delivering training, but your commercial conversations need to be grounded in a genuine understanding of how customers are using the product and where they are not.

**Retention and Renewal

**

• Monitor account health continuously and act on risk signals before they become churn conversations. If a customer is at risk, the Head of Customer Success should hear about it from you, not from the customer.

• Co-own the renewal conversation with the AE. Own the preparation, the relationship context, and the customer's readiness to renew; Sales owns the close.

• Escalate renewal risk early, with a clear view of what is driving it and what the options are.

**Growth and Expansion

**

• Identify and progress expansion opportunities in collaboration with the AE. This means having enough commercial awareness to spot the signal and enough credibility with the customer to explore it.

• Bring the Head of Customer Success into complex or large deals at the right moment, not after the conversation has already been shaped.

**Cross-functional Coordination

**

• Coordinate training delivery through Education. You are not responsible for delivering training; Education owns that. Your job is to ensure the right training reaches the right accounts at the right time.

• Work with the Programme Manager to ensure smooth onboarding for new accounts entering the portfolio.

• Provide context to Education Specialists before training sessions on Premier and Strategic accounts, so delivery is appropriately calibrated.

• Partner with Support and Product to close feedback loops and ensure customer insights are informing the right internal conversations.

**About You

**

• Significant experience managing complex, high-value B2B accounts at a senior level, with a track record of holding executive relationships and co-owning commercial outcomes alongside Sales.

• Strong executive presence and the ability to hold a relationship through difficult conversations, not just good ones.

• A background in shipping, maritime operations, or global trade is strongly preferred. Sedna serves some of the world's largest maritime businesses, and candidates who understand how those organisations operate will be better placed to build credible, lasting relationships with them.

• Commercially fluent: able to read a renewal situation, understand what is driving it, and act with appropriate urgency without waiting to be asked.

• Clear, structured communicator in writing and in person, comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders and leading commercial conversations.

• Familiarity with Salesforce or equivalent CRM. Experience with tools such as Mixpanel or Snowflake is an advantage.

**What Success Looks Like

**

• A portfolio where no renewal, escalation, or expansion conversation comes as a surprise, because you have been managing the signals well in advance.

• Executive relationships on Premier accounts that are strong enough that customers would describe you as genuinely useful, not just present.

• Net Revenue Retention at or above target, with a clear understanding of what drove the result in both directions.

• Expansion pipeline contribution in partnership with Sales, with opportunities identified and progressed rather than waited for.

• Customer insights flowing consistently into QBRs, product feedback, and internal planning.

**Directional KPIs

**

• Net Revenue Retention on portfolio

• Logo retention rate on portfolio

• Expansion ARR generated

• Renewal on-time rate

• QBR completion rate against plan

• Time to escalation on at-risk accounts (faster is better)

• Executive relationship health, qualitative, assessed quarterly by Head of Customer Success

• Training coordination rate: proportion of accounts receiving at least one Education touchpoint per quarter

**Our Values:

**Finally, culture is important to us, so we also look for candidates who share our values:

**Stay Ahead, Stay Agile

**

• We don’t just adapt-we anticipate change and act with confidence.

• Curiosity, data, and customer insights help us stay ahead of the curve.

• We embrace challenges as opportunities and remain resilient under pressure.

• By staying open to new ideas and ways of working, we lead the future.

**Execute With Focus

**

• We turn strategy into action, delivering measurable results that matter.

• Every initiative counts-discipline and ownership drive business impact.

• We make smart decisions with speed, balancing pace and precision.

• Clear priorities keep us focused on what moves the needle.

**Work Together, Win Together

**

• Collaboration is our superpower-we succeed as one team, internally and with customers.

• We co-create solutions, seek feedback, and build the future of the OS together.

• Strong relationships are built on trust, respect, and shared goals.

• By aligning across teams and with customers, we unlock greater impact.

jobs.occupation: Field Service Engineer - Instrumentation radar systems
jobs.description:
Do you want to become a specialist in advanced radar systems and use your engineering skills to troubleshoot, analyze and solve complex technical challenges for customers around the world?

At Weibel, you will join a truly international and technology-driven company that develops advanced radar systems for both defense and civil applications across the world. Our strong technology and close customer partnerships have secured us success in the market and continuous growth.

As part of this growth, we are looking for a skilled Field Service Engineer with a strong engineering mindset to join our Aftermarket Service Team within Instrumentation. This is an opportunity to take your engineering skills into real-world applications, working hands-on with advanced radar technology and solving complex system-level challenges directly with our customers.

Your role

As Field Service Engineer in the Instrumentation team, you will work hands-on with advanced Weibel radar systems used by customers worldwide for high-precision test, measurement and tracking applications.

You will play a key role throughout the technical lifecycle of the systems, from final system testing and verification to installation, integration, operation, troubleshooting, maintenance and upgrades. The position combines system-level engineering, technical problem-solving and direct customer interaction, requiring you to understand how complex hardware and software systems work together in real-world applications.

Your primary tasks include:

• Pre-FAT / SAT system testing and Customer FAT / SAT testing

• Installation, system integration, configuration and acceptance testing of Weibel radar systems

• Technical troubleshooting and diagnostics of complex system issues, both on site and remotely

• On-site mission support, including system setup, verification and performance assessment

• Preventive maintenance, technical upgrades and system modifications

• Analysis and documentation of system performance, technical findings and maintenance activities

• Root cause analysis of technical issues and development of recommendations for corrective actions

• Training of customer personnel in system operation and maintenance

We offer continuous training, and your responsibilities will increase as your expertise grows. Over time, you will develop deep technical knowledge of radar technology and the interaction between hardware, software and system performance, becoming a specialist within our systems and an important technical point of contact for both customers and colleagues.

The role includes international travel of up to 100 days per year, sometimes on short notice, and you must be able to travel freely within the EU and enter the United States under an ESTA permit or equivalent.

Your profile

We are looking for a technically curious engineer who enjoys understanding how complex systems work and solving problems that do not always have an obvious answer. You are motivated by combining analytical problem-solving with hands-on technical work and want to develop deep specialist knowledge within advanced radar systems.

You enjoy taking ownership of technical challenges, working systematically from problem to root cause, and applying your engineering knowledge in real-world environments. At the same time, you are comfortable working directly with customers and communicating technical topics in a clear and professional way.

We imagine that you bring:

• A relevant engineering or technical degree at minimum bachelor level, for example within electronics, electrical engineering, RF, mechatronics, automation, physics or similar

• Ability to read and interpret electrical, mechanical and RF schematics

• A good understanding of electronics, IT systems and the interaction between hardware and software

• A practical mindset and an interest in working hands-on with electronics, tools and test equipment

• An analytical and structured approach to troubleshooting and problem-solving

• Strong communication skills in written and spoken English

• As a person, you are curious, analytical and structured. You enjoy getting to the bottom of complex technical problems, remain calm when conditions change and communicate confidently with both colleagues and customers.

Please be aware that it is a requirement that you can provide a criminal record with no remarks and obtain security clearance.

Contact and application

Please apply at our website using the ‘Apply’ button.

If you have questions, you are very welcome to contact our Field Service Team Lead for Instrumentation, Nikolaj Skov Lillevang, at NISL@weibel.dk.

The deadline for your application is December 7th 2026.

We are looking forward to hearing from you.

Bliv en del af en dansk virksomhed

Weibel Scientific A/S er en danskejet ingeniørvirksomhed i kraftig vækst. Vi udvikler og producerer højteknologiske radarer til brug i bl.a. rumforskning, flyindustri, forsvar samt beskyttelse af kritisk infrastruktur. Vores hovedkvarter ligger i Allerød og beskæftiger knap 600 medarbejdere.

I Weibel kan du se frem til et spændende og udfordrende job i en dynamisk og fremtidsorienteret virksomhed med in-house produktion og højteknologisk udvikling.

Læs også meget mere om os på vores hjemmeside.

Do you want to build a new repair and service capability for Weibel's radar systems

At Weibel, we develop and produce advanced radar systems for customers across the world. As our installed base continues to grow, so does the need for a dedicated capability that can provide our customers with efficient and consistent support when their radar systems require spare part replacement, repair or system updates.

We are therefore establishing a new Repair & Service function within Aftermarket, covering both our Instrumentation and Surveillance radar systems. The ambition is to build a strong, independent capability that brings the competencies, team and processes together in one dedicated workshop.

Today, these activities draw on resources from Production and Field Service. By bringing the responsibility together we establish a specialized function within Aftermarket to improve turnaround time for our customers and enable Production and Field Service to focus on their core responsibilities. You will play a key role in turning that ambition into a strong, self-sufficient function.

Build the function from the ground up

You will report to our Aftermarket Director and take the lead in establishing and developing the new Repair & Service function.

You will shape the workshop, build the team and competencies and establish the processes needed to handle spare part replacements, repairs and system updates efficiently across our radar portfolio. You will have the opportunity to build your own area of responsibility and set the direction for how the function develops as it grows.

A strong customer perspective will be central to the role. You will take responsibility for the complete repair journey, from the moment a need is reported until the radar or component is repaired, updated and ready to return to operation. Short turnaround times, high quality and clear communication will be key measures of success.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Establishing the new Repair & Service workshop, including the physical setup, equipment and workflows

• Building and developing the team and the technical competencies needed to support our radar systems

• Establishing efficient processes for spare part replacement, repair, system updates and testing

• Leading and developing the team and setting clear direction and priorities as the function grows

• Developing the spare parts setup needed to support an efficient Repair & Service operation together with Production and Warehouse

• Building strong collaboration with Production, Field Service and relevant technical functions across Weibel

• Using operational insights to continuously improve quality, turnaround time and the customer experience

Your first three priorities

When you join, your first focus will be to turn the ambition into a functioning Repair & Service capability:

• Understand the complete Repair & Service flow: Get close to the cases we handle today and understand the journey from the customer request until the radar or component is ready to return to operation. This will give you the foundation to identify the capabilities and processes the new function needs.

• Build the team and the workshop: Bring the right competencies together and establish the physical setup, tools and ways of working needed for the function to increasingly handle cases independently.

• Build first-hand knowledge of our radar systems: Work hands-on with current repair cases to understand our systems, typical faults and the technical capabilities your team needs to develop.

Your profile

You are a hands-on technical leader who is motivated by building something new and making it work. You enjoy creating structure where the path is not yet fully defined and know how to turn technical expertise into a strong team and a well-functioning operation.

You understand what it takes to troubleshoot, repair and test complex technical systems and can move comfortably between technical challenges, leadership and cross-functional collaboration.

We imagine that you bring:

• A relevant technical background within electronics, electrical or mechanical engineering, or equivalent practical experience

• Hands-on experience with troubleshooting, repair and testing of advanced electronic, instrumentation or comparable technical systems

• Experience leading and developing technical specialists

• Experience establishing, developing or scaling a workshop, service or repair function

• A structured approach to processes, quality and continuous improvement

• Understanding of spare parts and material flows

• Strong communication skills in Danish and English

• Most importantly, you have the drive to take ownership and build a new function into a strong capability

Contact and application

Please apply through our website using the Apply button.

If you have any questions, you are very welcome to contact our Aftermarket Director, Jakob Brade, at JABR@weibel.dk.

The deadline for applications is December 6, 2026.

Please be aware that employment requires a criminal record with no remarks and the ability to obtain security clearance.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Become part of a Danish company

Weibel Scientific A/S is a Danish-owned engineering company experiencing strong growth. We develop and manufacture high‑technology radar systems for use in areas such as space research, aviation, defense, and the protection of critical infrastructure. We are a world leader in the development of Doppler radars and, since our establishment in 1977, we have delivered more than 4,500 state‑of‑the‑art radar systems to over 40 countries.

Our headquarters are located in Allerød and employ nearly 600 people.

At Weibel, you can look forward to an exciting and challenging position in a dynamic and forward‑looking company with in‑house production and advanced technological development.

Read more about us on our website.

Develop physics-based wind and solar models and the Python software that brings them into daily use in energy trading.

The role

You will develop physics-based models of wind and solar production and build the Python software that puts them into reliable daily operation. Your work will support data validation, pricing, and hedging across our client business.

Over time, you will become the go-to person for asset modelling, taking ownership of model quality, and ensuring that consistent, traceable assumptions underpin our pricing and hedging decisions.

The team

The Pricing team develops and operates the models and analytical infrastructure used to evaluate deals and manage risk across our client business. We focus on making results reliable, traceable and useful for the decisions they support.

You will work alongside a software developer, quantitative developers and pricing analysts, while collaborating closely with colleagues in Forecasting, Portfolio Management and Client Success.

Your responsibilities

• Develop, validate and maintain physics-based wind and solar models, translating weather data and asset characteristics into expected production.

• Validate historical production data and distinguish underlying production potential from the effects of outages, curtailment and trading decisions.

• Build reusable Python components to calculate and store production estimates and expected volumes, ensuring traceability and reproducibility.

• Develop, test, deploy and operate Python models and supporting software, including monitoring, troubleshooting and maintenance.

• Develop and maintain day-ahead and intraday renewable asset hindcasts used in pricing.

• Work with our Forecasting team to incorporate in-house weather data and forecasting methods into our asset models.

• Assess external production indices against our models and document the assumptions behind the analysis.

Our asset models are the foundation for how we price renewable energy contracts and estimate the volumes we hedge in the market. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their models, challenges the status quo and works closely with colleagues to turn theory into practice.

René Meklenborg Miltersen Slot

Manager, Pricing

What we are looking for

You combine expertise in both wind and solar production modelling with strong Python skills and experience taking software into production. You take ownership of model quality and reliability, challenge assumptions and assess whether more complex models add practical value given the uncertainty involved.

We will help you develop your knowledge of pricing, hedging and energy markets. Previous experience in these areas is welcome but not required.

We expect you to have

• A Master’s degree in engineering, physics, renewable energy or a related field.

• Several years of relevant experience in renewable asset modelling, energy yield assessment or a related technical role.

• Hands-on experience with reanalysis data, weather data and measured production time series.

• Solid experience modelling wind production, including turbine power curves and wake effects.

• Solid experience with PV performance modelling and the main drivers of solar production.

• Strong Python skills and experience developing, testing, deploying and operating models or analytical software in production.

• Experience using AI tools in daily coding, analysis or modelling, with a critical approach to reviewing and validating their outputs.

• The ability to communicate technical results clearly and collaborate across technical and commercial teams.

Advantageous experience

• Experience with historical weather forecasts, hindcasts or forecast verification.

• Experience combining physical models with statistical methods to improve production estimates.

• Familiarity with energy markets, PPA pricing or portfolio hedging.

What we offer

• Ownership of our renewable asset modelling capability, with a direct impact on commercial performance.

• The opportunity to combine renewable energy engineering, Python development and quantitative modelling in power markets.

• Hands-on modelling of real wind and solar assets using weather data and measured production.

• Close collaboration with developers, analysts, forecasters and portfolio managers.

• A strong technical environment, with room to shape our models and the analytical services around them.

• Competitive salary and attractive employment terms.

Interested?

If you bring expertise in wind and solar modelling and experience deploying and operating Python software, we would like to hear from you.

Want to know more?

Feel free to reach out if you have any questions about this opportunity

René Meklenborg Miltersen Slot

Manager, Pricing
